## Overview

MarkdStage v3.1.0 improves PowerPoint export and slide layout fidelity. Theme-aware
PowerPoint layouts now preserve the selected visual style, code blocks remain editable,
fallback artwork is split into editable regions, and bullet lists export correctly.
Excessive body spacing in exported slides is also reduced.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks, Canvas
Extension installations, CLI workflows, and Architecture DSL v1 documents.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.1.0`. |
| Offline CLI installation | Download and install `markdstage-markdstage-3.1.0.tgz` from the GitHub Release. |
